llm_response.reason: The website mixes recognizable brand names (OLX, Lazada) with content promoting online slots and offers a confusing, template-based layout. This mimicry of legitimate marketplace designs, together with the non-coherent blend of gambling promotions and e-commerce categories and ambiguous corporate information, matches several scam characteristics such as imitating legit companies, using aggressive promotions, and ambiguous customer support details.
